newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso slips back 2.2 pesos against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso slips back 2.2 pesos against dollar.

text.p: Colombia's peso slipped back 2.2 to close at 1,011.9 pesos against the dollar, interbank traders said.

Dealers said there was an initial wave of speculation by banks looking to make a quick profit and later in the session the dollar was pushed up by demand for greenbacks by a number of foreign multinationals.

The fall in the peso came at the end of a week of sharp gains during which the Colombian currency clawed its way back from a rate of 1,025 per dollar last Friday to the week's low of 1,009 by midsession Thursday.

Dealers reported 313 operations worth a total $142.9 million. They predicted the peso would continue to remain close to the ceiling of the central bank's daily floating exchange rate band as there was still a surplus of dollars in the market.
